llm.summary: This is a coherent Chinese-language business planning skill with markdown templates, no executable code, and no hidden persistence or credential handling.

dimensions.detail: It asks users for business context, target audience, pain points, and willingness-to-pay assumptions, and it recommends web search for competitor analysis; this is proportionate to the planning purpose but users should avoid sharing confidential data unnecessarily.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected artifact consists of markdown files only; no executable scripts, package installs, remote payloads, or installer-side behavior were present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger language is somewhat broad and the artifact is entirely in Chinese, but the activated behavior remains advisory and purpose-aligned rather than privileged or hidden.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No artifact evidence showed credential access, local profile/session use, persistent memory writes, background workers, scheduled tasks, privilege escalation, or destructive actions.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill’s capabilities match its stated purpose: it guides users through knowledge-IP positioning, audience research, content planning, course outlines, competitor analysis, and monetization planning.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Installers should treat this as a planning and market-research assistant. It may ask for commercially sensitive context and may use web search for competitor analysis, so provide only information you are comfortable using for advisory planning and verify monetization estimates independently.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The skill is Chinese-only, which may limit usability, but this is visible throughout the artifact and does not create hidden authority or security-impacting behavior.
[SQP-1] expected: The broad catch-all trigger covers knowledge systems, course design, IP positioning, and content planning; that is wider than ideal but still within the declared advisory business-planning scope and does not perform automatic high-impact actions.
